description: Scrapes a public page and fills your flat schema (up to 20 typed fields) from it. Values are type-checked. Returns { url, finalUrl, title, data, missing }: one value per field (typed, or null when the page does not say) and the required fields that came back null. Price: 10 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

schema.description: Flat JSON Schema of what to extract: { type: "object", properties: { <name>: { type: string|number|integer|boolean, description?, enum? } }, required? }. 1 to 20 fields; names match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,39}$; descriptions up to 200 characters; enums up to 20 values.

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses, internal hostnames and this service's own hosts are refused.

name: web-extract
title: Structured web extract
